keyword: when is the last time we went to the moon

verifications.claim: The last time humans went to the moon was during NASA's Apollo 17 mission.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "last time American on moon, Apollo 17" (R1); "The last time astronauts traveled that far was Apollo 17, in December 1972" (R2); "Apollo 17 — the final mission in the program, which was the last time humans traveled to the moon" (R3); "Apollo 17 became the last crewed mission to the Moon" (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple references directly state Apollo 17 as the last human moon mission.

verifications.claim: NASA's Apollo 17 mission landed on December 11, 1972.

verifications.reasoning: R7 directly confirms exact date; others consistent.
